name: @netandreus/pi-auto
description: pi-auto is a Pi package that provides the pi-auto MCP server and a Skill for pi-coding-agent: usage data from @ccusage/pi and tools to switch the active provider by strategy — load-balancing (equalize usage across backends) or high-availability (fixed priority order).
